_comment: What runs where. The manager combines this (authored roles) with each worker's derived public key into a signed /registry.json on the drive. A value may be a single role or an array. 5.3: worker-a AND worker-b both run echo — so 'find any echo provider' is ambiguous, and the client uses connect-by-key to target worker-b specifically (the reply names the worker, proving which node served it). Edit + re-seed to re-place responsibilities.
